query paymentDetailQuery($referenceId: Int!, $orderHash: String!, $paymentKey: String!, $paymentType: String!) {
  paymentDetail(referenceId: $referenceId, orderHash: $orderHash, paymentKey: $paymentKey) {
    data {
      creditCardTokenization {
        token {
          cardHolderExpiredMonth
          cardHolderExpiredYear
          cardHolderName
          cardHolderNumber
          cardHolderType
          paymentToken
          __typename
        }
        __typename
      }
      installmentDetails {
        currency
        grandTotal
        installmentMonth
        payMonthly
        text
        __typename
      }
      paymentDetailImages
      paymentExpired
      paymentMessage {
        idID
        enUS
        __typename
      }
      recentKlikBCAId
      sidebarPayment {
        subTotal
        grandTotal
        convertedCurrency
        convertedAmount
        serviceCharge
        uniqueCode
        orderDetail {
          currency
          orderName
          orderNameDetail
          referenceDetailId
          productType
          tixPoint
          totalPrice
          breakdownPrice {
            key
            value
            valueString
            __typename
          }
          __typename
        }
        __typename
      }
      oneKlikCards {
        maxCard
        cards {
          xcoid
          credentialNumber
          maxLimit
          __typename
        }
        __typename
      }
      checkAvailabilityDiscount {
        code
        message
        data
        __typename
      }
      __typename
    }
    code
    message
    serverTime
    __typename
  }
  paymentSidebar(referenceId: $referenceId, orderHash: $orderHash) {
    data {
      full_name
      id_card
      salutation
      balanceAmount
      balanceAmountString
      cashback
      cashbackString
      cashbackTIX
      cashbackTIXString
      grandTotal
      grandTotalString
      referenceId
      serviceCharge
      serviceChargeString
      subTotal
      subTotalString
      uniqueCode
      uniqueCodeString
      orderDetail {
        currency
        orderName
        orderNameDetail
        productType
        referenceDetailId
        tixPoint
        totalPrice
        totalPriceString
        breakdownPrice {
          key
          value
          valueString
          __typename
        }
        __typename
      }
      __typename
    }
    code
    message
    errors
    __typename
  }
  order(orderId: $referenceId, orderHash: $orderHash, pay: $paymentType)
}

query orderDetailQuery($referenceId: Int!, $orderHash: String!, $paymentKey: String) {
  paymentSidebar(referenceId: $referenceId, orderHash: $orderHash, paymentKey: $paymentKey) {
    data {
      full_name
      id_card
      salutation
      balanceAmount
      balanceAmountString
      cashback
      cashbackString
      cashbackTIX
      cashbackTIXString
      grandTotal
      grandTotalString
      referenceId
      serviceCharge
      serviceChargeString
      subTotal
      subTotalString
      uniqueCode
      uniqueCodeString
      orderDetail {
        currency
        orderName
        orderNameDetail
        productType
        referenceDetailId
        tixPoint
        totalPrice
        totalPriceString
        breakdownPrice {
          key
          value
          valueString
          __typename
        }
        __typename
      }
      __typename
    }
    code
    message
    errors
    __typename
  }
  order(orderId: $referenceId, orderHash: $orderHash)
}

query rescheduleCashback($rescheduleOrderId: Int!, $rescheduleOrderHash: String!) {
  rescheduleCashback(rescheduleOrderId: $rescheduleOrderId, rescheduleOrderHash: $rescheduleOrderHash) {
    code
    message
    errors
    data {
      bankTransfer
      bankTransferFee
      breakdownOldPrice {
        additional
        name
        price
        __typename
      }
      breakdownPrice {
        additional
        name
        price
        __typename
      }
      cardHolderName
      cardNumber
      cardType
      cashback
      cashbackTix
      cashbackTixWorth
      ccFee
      creditcard
      finalRescheduleCashback
      kredivo
      kredivoFee
      total
      totalBankTransfer
      totalCc
      totalKredivo
      __typename
    }
    __typename
  }
}
